# Mutants for a namespace read as a value (#67jk7wq)

Each mutant is one edit, run against the tests it names, then put back from a saved copy. The oracle rows run with `ADAMIC_GATE_UNCACHED=1`. The lower tests are in internal/lower/namespace_value_test.go, the oracle's in internal/oracle/namespace_value_test.go.

| Mutant | Edit | Red |
|---|---|---|
| (1) A fresh object per read | internal/lower/namespace_value.go, `namespaceValueRead`: `value := ir.Expression(ir.Read{Local: l.namespaceContainer(declaration), Of: ir.Object})` made `value, _ := l.namespaceContainerLiteral(declaration)`, so each read makes its own object and the one made at block start is never read | TestNamespaceValueAgreesWithNode/identity/main.a, native, sanitized and javascript: `same false false false` where Node prints `same true true true`. TestNamespaceValueAgreesWithNode/tracing/main.a with it: `started object false` where Node prints `started object true`. TestNamespaceValueIdentityAgrees (lower) on the JavaScript backend. `a.f === Counter.f` stays true: each fresh object's fields are still the functions' canonical values |
| (2) The merged-blocks stop dropped | internal/lower/namespaces.go, `namespaceRefusal`: `if l.namespaceHasValue(node) && l.namespaceBlocks(node) > 1 {` made `if false && l.namespaceHasValue(node) && l.namespaceBlocks(node) > 1 {` | TestNamespaceValueStops/merged_blocks: the program stops as main's "a reopened namespace or namespace merged with a runtime value" instead of "a namespace merged across blocks used as a value". It can't disagree with Node: main's reopened stop, at the same first block, still fails the program closed. The row's program reads `typeof early.g` between the blocks, where Node prints `undefined`, so lifting both stops with an object made whole at the first block would print `function` there |
| (3) The readiness check dropped for the value read | internal/lower/namespace_value.go, `namespaceValueRead`: `check := l.namespaceReadyCheck(declaration, ...)` made `check := ir.Expression(ir.BooleanConstant{Value: true})` | TestNamespaceValueReadBeforeItsBlockIsChecked: native and the JavaScript backend read the container's undefined, print `undefined` and `1` and exit 0, where the check stopped with exit 70 |
| (4) A read through `typeof N` by the namespace object's slot | internal/native/fields.go, `uniformFieldOffsets`' `record`: `offsets[field.Name] = -1 // A conflict stays a conflict, even if a later layout agrees.` made `continue` | **Survives** (Codex 01a1c5d5-1dbf-70a1-b414-9c9285cbb025 at fb812415, log at emit/namespace-value-literal-proof 0c05e273): TestNamespaceValueAgreesWithNode/literal.a stays green natively, sanitized and on JavaScript. literal.a's reads are calls, which find their function by name, not through a uniform slot, so this edit doesn't reach them. literal.a stays as Language's control: no code in this head reads a namespace value by slot, and the pin is there to catch the change that would |

Run: mutants (1) and (3) went red as written above on Codex session 01a1c5b1-81b0-7077-8166-fce06d568007 (go 1.27.1, clang 20.1.8, node 24.19) at 71900e08, the log at emit/namespace-value-mutants c16bff89 (proof/ns-mut.log). (1) turned TestNamespaceValueAgreesWithNode's two programs red natively, sanitized and on JavaScript, and TestNamespaceValueIdentityAgrees on JavaScript; TestNamespaceValueStops' ten rows stayed green, as they should. (3) turned TestNamespaceValueReadBeforeItsBlockIsChecked red: native exit 0, printing `undefined` and `1`. Unmutated, every step of the proof was green on Codex session 01a1c584-95a9-720d-8d5c-1910271b603d (log at emit/namespace-value-proof 6fca8299), but for five internal/lower census tests that need the pinned TypeScript source.

(5) The argument judged at the call site: internal/lower/namespace_value.go, namespaceValueArgument's `declared := l.namespaceDeclaredParameter(call, outer, signature)` made `declared := l.slotType(outer)`. TestNamespaceValueStops' generic class parameter and generic interface parameter rows go red, each with `got <nil>`, so both programs lower without the fix (Lower's must). Run on Codex 01a1c5c8-4e4e-75f0-ab6c-c7d164a1600b at 8bb20561, log at emit/namespace-value-fix-proof 36788ab8. Unmutated, every internal/lower namespace and never-rest test passed in the same session.
